graph/description:
**How fast is it rising?** Bars: NOAA's annual growth (ppb per year); line: the monthly growth rate, the trend's 12-month change. Beneath, ENSO (the Oceanic Niño Index): red El Niño, blue La Niña.

The 2020–2022 surge coincided with a triple-dip La Niña (wetter tropical wetlands emit more) and with COVID lockdowns (less NOx, so less OH to destroy methane).

*Be aware:* across 40 years ENSO alone tracks growth poorly; the strongest correlation, at its best lag, is shown under the chart.
